custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar, click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Reach.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Open Column Selection and turn on every field. Close the picker.
  5. Scroll down inside Esther Howard's column to the last card.
  6. Read every field on the last card.
  7. Click "Card size" and choose "Compact". Scroll down inside Esther Howard's column to the last card and read it.
  8. Click "Card size" and choose "Detailed".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • You can scroll to the very last card in the column.
  • Every field you turned on is fully visible on the last card: nothing is cut off at the bottom of the column. In Compact too you can scroll to the very last card and it is fully visible, with nothing cut off at the bottom of the column (Compact shows only the number, status, assign button, customer and asset).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-E4, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E4: “Keep all selected card content reachable by scrolling, regardless of card height or density.”
  • S3-E4 is checked in both card sizes: Card size (S3-R11a) shipped with SV-11581 (PRD version 81, 27 Oct 2026).

Last checked against build v26.43.2-9272076 (QA branch sv11581) on 10/29/2026.
